name: novita/baichuan/baichuan-m2-32b
description: Baichuan-M2 is a medically-enhanced reasoning model specifically designed for real-world medical reasoning tasks. We begin with real-world medical questions and conduct reinforcement learning training based on a large-scale verifier system. While maintaining the model's general capabilities, the medical effectiveness of Baichuan-M2 has achieved breakthrough improvements.
